acceptanceCriteria.text: `architecture:check` passes on current `main` without suppressing or weakening unsafe-type-escape enforcement.
Documentation governance accepts the repository tree; the README hero asset is placed/classified through the existing canonical documentation taxonomy rather than an ad-hoc allowlist.
Managed-runtime tests do not depend on ambient write permission to `/var/lib/mottainai-control/managed-runtime`; production ownership semantics remain unchanged.
Zellij package/e2e setup and assertions derive from one existing canonical supported-version authority and cannot silently drift.
`suzukuri@0.2.2` passes the existing minimum-release-age policy naturally; no exception, age reduction, alternate registry, downgrade, or bypass is introduced.

After the release-age condition is satisfied, repository-required full verification and PR CI are green from a clean environment, or any newly discovered independent baseline failure is reported and split rather than hidden.
Canon/C2/C3/Manager product semantics remain unchanged except where strictly required to remove the concrete architecture violation.
No Nix Runtime/Golden Path product change is included. If reproduction proves such ownership, stop that subtask and split it into a separate Issue.
